flags.title: Five optional assignments per season

flags.title: Article XX-D: the right to walk
flags.why: Crossed 3 years of service this season: may elect free agency if outrighted.

flags.title: 60-day IL and the November crunch
flags.why: On the 60-day IL: not counting against the 40-man now, but must be reinstated by Nov 5 (5th day after the World Series).

flags.title: Injured players cannot be sent down
flags.why: On the Major League injured list: cannot be optioned or outrighted until he is healthy and reinstated, so an injured fringe player keeps his roster spot by default.

flags.title: Post-season roster eligibility
flags.why: On the 60-day IL before the cutoff, so he is on the eligibility list. He has served the 60 days (177), so the only step is reinstatement: the club must open a 40-man spot and a 26-man spot before the series roster is submitted.
